test_title: PYST 08: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

"The principal might be watching the surveillance footage."

options.text: The surveillance footage is being watched.
The surveillance footage might be watched.
The surveillance footage might be being watched by the principal.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The principal might be watching the surveillance footage."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the surveillance footage" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "might be watching" to "might be being watched" (modal + continuous passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the principal."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The surveillance footage might be being watched by the principal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The surveillance footage is being watched." – Incorrect as it does not include the modal verb "might."
 
• **Option 2: **"The surveillance footage might watched." – Incorrect as it lacks proper grammar (missing "be").
 
• **Option 3: **"The surveillance footage might be watched." – Incorrect as it does not capture the continuous aspect ("being watched").
